🎬 John Adams (2008)

John Adams follows the extraordinary life of one of America’s most influential Founding Fathers, tracing his journey from a respected Massachusetts lawyer to a revolutionary leader and eventually the second President of the United States. Set during the turbulent years surrounding the American Revolution, the series explores Adams’s determination to challenge British rule and help establish an independent nation. Alongside political figures such as George Washington, Thomas Jefferson, and Benjamin Franklin, Adams becomes deeply involved in the difficult negotiations, dangerous decisions, and ideological conflicts that shape the birth of the United States. Meanwhile, his marriage to Abigail Adams provides an emotional foundation for the story, revealing the personal sacrifices and family struggles that accompany his growing political responsibilities. As Adams travels between America and Europe, he faces diplomatic challenges, disagreements with fellow revolutionaries, and the enormous pressure of helping build a functioning government. His outspoken personality, strong convictions, and complicated relationships frequently create tension with other leaders, forcing him to navigate the difficult balance between principle and political compromise. From the signing of the Declaration of Independence to his years serving as president, the series captures the triumphs and hardships of a man whose contributions helped shape American history. Combining detailed historical storytelling, powerful performances, political intrigue, and emotional family drama, John Adams explores patriotism, leadership, sacrifice, marriage, ambition, and the complicated struggle to establish American independence.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • History

⭐ IMDb: 8.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 7 episodes • Approximately 8h 21m total • TV-14

🎥 Director: Tom Hooper
